WNV surveillance in California is highly seasonal (peak: July–October); August 2024 falls within peak transmission — expect elevated case volumes and frequent report updates.
CDPH VBDS weekly reports are the primary authoritative source for California WNV human cases; prioritize these over county-level press releases for statewide totals.
ArboNET data for 2024 may not be finalized until 2025 — treat any 2024 ArboNET figures as provisional.
Do not invent or hallucinate URLs; source_url must be populated only from directly retrieved documents during collection, not from this intelligence profile.

Evidence quotes must be verbatim excerpts from source documents; do not paraphrase or synthesize across sources for a single evidence_quote field.
Hospitalization data for WNV in California is inconsistently reported at the county level — flag missing hospitalization data explicitly rather than leaving field blank without notation.
